name: claudebrain
description: Live synapse-graph visualizer for Claude Code — watch every session, skill, tool call, and file edit light up in real time

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && esbuild web/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/web/app.js && cp web/index.html web/style.css dist/web/
scripts.dev: npm run build && node dist/cli.js start
